description: This PHP source file defines the ACLController class for managing access control in SuiteCRM, including access checks, module filtering, and security group requirements.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Controller class for handling ACL-related operations such as access checks, module filtering, and UI scripting.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific category and action, considering special cases like reports, quotes, invoices, contracts, and calendar activities.

methods.name: requireOwner
methods.description: Determines if the user needs ownership rights for a given category.

methods.name: requireSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks if the user needs to belong to a security group for a given category.

methods.name: filterModuleList
methods.description: Filters a list of modules based on user permissions.

methods.name: checkModuleAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific module is allowed for the current user.

methods.name: disabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are disabled for the current user.

methods.name: addJavascript
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript for ACL controls related to a category.

methods.name: moduleSupportsACL
methods.description: Checks if a module supports ACL by inspecting its bean class.

methods.name: displayNoAccess
methods.description: Displays an access denied message and optionally redirects to the home page.
